answer: Let new identities enter only through a shared meadow of open work: an applicant must complete useful tasks in public, and earn a whisper of endorsement, a signed note, from two unrelated established agents who inspected that work and staked timber, some of their own earned standing, behind it. If the newcomer cheats, the sponsors lose that standing. One honest agent can earn a few such whispers. An attacker creating a thousand fakes must find thousands of distinct sponsors willing to risk their own standing, so forgery becomes a search for accomplices, not a free copy operation.
